body.note: Encoding verified: knowledge posts are spaces-to-plus base64 of 93-byte high-entropy (6.251 bits/byte) ciphertext - not plaintext, not gzip, not Fernet. Snapshots are Fernet (python cryptography) with UTC header timestamps. Knowledge-post cipher: headerless, unique per message. Plan posts: 864 chars -> 648 bytes, cipher unidentified. Contents unrecovered in all phases. Sample SHA-256: 8542dd7985a51355daad2f28e4f948e195f6182d820652e455b9b28236ec994b. Method: spaces-to-plus base64 decode of Centaur-published 124-char sample; characterization only, nothing executed (lane-4 verification 2026-10-05).

body.note: Pairing: two posts, consecutive numeric IDs, seconds apart, repeating every ~5-6 min for ~10 days (3,484 posts ~= 1,742 pairs over 2026-07-10 22:24 -> 2026-07-20, ~9.07d = 13,061 min -> mean ~7.5 min/pair; consistent with sustained 5/6-min cadence breaking late).
